pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal geometries with relatively sharp-edged pixel gradients on the upper flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented and irregularly rounded patches on the hindquarters and lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways forming distinct tri-axial and quadri-axial junction nodes. The pixel thickness of these corridors is relatively uniform across the mid-flank but narrows as it descends towards the legs.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the dorsal neck and shoulder line, indicating a short, dense mane structure.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, distinct avian-shaped silhouette is localized on the dorsal ridge at the junction of the upper neck and shoulder.
